verdict.rationale: Gram distributes tools as hosted MCP servers that MCP clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot can connect to, and its CLI installs toolsets into AI agents. The evidence contains no documented adapters or integrations for the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. Generic MCP-client connectivity is an adjacent capability, not the framework adapters this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
